comment: Where the daily watch (scripts/release/watch_dependencies.py) reads each pinned extension's security advisories: GitHub's published repository advisories, GET /repos/{repo}/security-advisories. Reviewed by hand, never guessed at run time. 'packages' lists the package names (case-insensitive) an advisory's vulnerability entry may carry for this extension; any other name in that repository is reported as a warning. An extension with no public advisory source says why. Every extension in browser/distribution/extensions.lock.json must be here (a unit test).

sources.reason: the source is in the ProtonMail/WebClients monorepo, which publishes no repository advisories; Proton has no machine-readable feed. Only the AMO blocklist check covers it
